title: DaNMP
description: DaNMP(Definitely a Normal ModPack) tries to make Minecraft more.. Vanilla+ i say? while trying to keep it's vanilla feel.
body:
(Hint: you can find a way to re-enable the quit button, puzzle time!) ((or just close the game, im not the boss im the creator))

Welcome to DanMP! this modpack will have a short discription for how short the modpack MAY be. so, first off, DaNMP is a sort of Vanilla+ pack, why i say that is there are some mods that change the game a BIT.. like changing the Mob AI to make it more difficult. And also slightly changed biomes and shaders EXT. I won't say much about it since i want to keep the MAIN reason why it's named DaNMP(Definitely a Normal ModPack) a secret. you may realise why it's named that once you create a world but it doesn't matter right now

what matters is that this modpack is _**normal!**_ **don't think otherwise**, Enjoy! :P
(1st: everything has been tested by me, there should be no bugs, 2nd, i will only make edits to my modpacks, never truly update it)

Lastly, i didn't say this before, it says singleplayer only, but if you would like to play multiplayer, it is recommended to download essentials(or a mod like that) to play multiplayer and see if it works, I've never tested it yet bc i was focused on the singleplayer aspect of the modpack. Thats all, Enjoy the modpack! :3
